The full live server uses SQLite storage, so PostgreSQL scheduler/runtime qualification remains open.
capabilities.summary: Kafka JSON polling with Ronin-owned offsets, durable SQLite compare-and-set checkpoints, checkpoint-safe micro-batches, identity transforms, idempotent Parquet sinks, bounded event-time windows, durable stream tables, scheduler-event integration, bounded health/lag, canonical stream-definition Bundles and stream-to-event-triggered workflows exist. Ronin enforces a 1 MiB record cap and 8 MiB micro-batch cap with bounded librdkafka fetch/queue settings; oversized and poison records fail before sink/checkpoint advancement. D99 adds current-harness local event-to-checkpoint retry evidence: after the real SQLite event store commits before a simulated pre-CAS failure, the checkpoint stays unchanged and a retry preserves one sink row and one delivery; 14/14 runtime tests and Ruff pass. D98 adds real Redpanda/API event-workflow evidence; D97 bounded supervisor-duration evidence; D96 live Parquet cap/resume/reset/replay; D93 65,536-record high-volume evidence. The production implementation boundary is 8afd9df8. D38-D98 provide earlier bounded recovery, bundle, backlog, byte-boundary, multi-broker, worker and route evidence in their stated candidate scopes. The bounded cases do not prove same-candidate indefinite supervisor operation, production topology support, broader provider breadth, scheduler restart recovery or full P11 qualification; the not-rerun full-suite/scan lanes remain explicit.

Durable normalized metrics/events, configurable pending/firing/open/resolved alert state transitions with cooldown and acknowledgement persistence, deterministic alert and budget notification intents with durable delivery attempts/errors/backoff, bounded SMTP and HTTPS webhook delivery, dependency-free deterministic Prometheus text export, reusable execution instrumentation, LocalWorkerRuntime instrumentation callbacks in one-shot and continuous loops, usage pricing, actual-versus-estimated cost records, non-ledger forecast projections, budget evaluation, deny-new-work budget_gate decisions, and bounded explainable anomaly hooks exist. D34 preserves the D33 slotted FinOps HTTP fix and restores legacy payload normalization; a real digest-pinned OTLP Collector lane passes 1/1. D33 separately proves local SQLite/control-plane/PyRonin/CLI usage, exact Decimal cost/budget payloads, workspace-scoped alert evaluation/acknowledgement and restart persistence; external provider adoption and production qualification remain incomplete.

Single-operator bearer authorization, transport policy, fail-closed policy checks, classification-aware actions, secret resolver ports, redaction, audit foundations, security reporting policy and release dependency evidence form the Public baseline. OIDC multi-user login, user/group provisioning, membership administration and multi-user role management belong to Ronin Pro; external-provider qualification remains incomplete.

Local/container/Compose foundation, PostgreSQL metadata adapter and healthcheck, wired PostgreSQL JobStore, single-node PostgreSQL lifecycle qualification, SQLite online backup/restore with path-bound manifests, PostgreSQL dump verification, S3-compatible artifact adapter, Kubernetes Job lifecycle adapter, forward-only migration qualification and recovery runbooks exist. D37 exact-candidate evidence adds real Compose appliance restoration plus Helm/kind single-replica install, health, Studio/API access, revision-2 upgrade, rollback to revision 1, job persistence through pod restart, Secret boundary and isolated cleanup. Multi-user Helm, multi-worker server operation and scheduler HA are Ronin Pro capabilities; external object-store backup/recovery, supported-platform coverage, full scheduler conformance and external provider qualification remain incomplete.

Deterministic verified archive IO, shared verified archive reading across importers, semantic inventory, native project/connection round-trips with explicit runtime/secret remapping, atomic multi-object project+connection commit, workflow/schedule round-trips, quality-contract portability, governed ontology-definition portability, atomic SQLite semantic model/dashboard imports with exact replay, canonical stream-definition portability with explicit binding remaps and checkpoint reset/resume policy, ML lab/pipeline and experiment/run/registered-model metadata portability, lakehouse table-metadata portability, and explicit catalog asset/revision/lineage selected-subgraph export/planning/atomic commit exist; PostgreSQL adapters for several domains, cross-domain import recovery, full native certification and public API surfaces remain incomplete.

Deterministic fixture discovery and fail-closed notebook-item translation exist with CLI/report tests; authenticated discovery, canonical import/export integration, provider compatibility and certification remain incomplete.

Deterministic fixture discovery and fail-closed notebook-job translation with dependency and schedule mapping exist with CLI/report tests; authenticated discovery, canonical import/export integration, provider compatibility and certification remain incomplete.

Deterministic fixture discovery and fail-closed Python-function translation exist with CLI/report tests; authenticated discovery, canonical import/export integration, provider compatibility and certification remain incomplete.

Deterministic fixture discovery and fail-closed Python/SQL recipe translation exist with CLI/report tests; authenticated discovery, canonical import/export integration, provider compatibility and certification remain incomplete.

Authenticated static Studio shell supports job listing/detail/events/evidence/cancellation, navigation, packaged assets, project-scoped read-only SQL with a local backend, workspace/project and environment operations, resource-scoped permission inspection, Bundle actions, governed pipeline execution and Monitoring & Alerts backed by APIs. Authoring editors, domain workflows and complete Public v1 journeys remain incomplete.

CI is intentionally absent. The D38 clean candidate has exact streaming recovery 2/2, artifact 92/92, static checks, Trivy 0/0 and fail-closed supply-chain receipts; the candidate archive browser lane is SKIP, license decisions are missing and external provider/recovery lanes remain open. Security/legal/product approvals, provider matrix, manual visual review, governance and complete capability-family qualification remain open; release is still NO-GO at 1/13 families and 0/10 gates.

human_decisions.summary: License/NOTICE/attribution conclusions and release approval remain human review decisions.
Mutation qualification remains retired; a new campaign requires an explicit product decision and plan.

Complete P2 provider/format/failure-recovery coverage for HTTP/REST, generic JDBC, PostgreSQL, S3/Azure/Ozone profiles; distinguish local emulators from production provider certification.

Close P5 scheduler gaps with full controller/daemon recovery, supported Compose restart behavior, PostgreSQL task evidence, and notification-provider/operator conformance.
Complete P6 catalog/ontology asset-family integration and provider/consumer certification; complete P7 provider qualification for quality contracts and release decisions.
Complete remaining P8 classical-ML capabilities only where required by the public scope; qualify durable artifacts/providers and end-to-end Studio journeys. No GenAI runtime.

Complete P10 semantic export/import qualification; for P11 add broader operational evidence and qualify the complete family on a clean candidate; complete P12 SDK parity, service adoption and alert/FinOps operational journeys.
Complete P13 external-provider qualification and P14 backup/restore, migration and single-node Helm qualification; keep Ronin Pro multi-user/HA outside Public v1.
Finish native Bundle PostgreSQL adapters, cross-domain rollback/recovery and API/CLI/Studio round trips; verify exact replay and remapping for every supported domain.
Resolve human release decisions: package versions, public claims, license/NOTICE/attribution reviews and release approval. Do not infer or fabricate legal approval.

Run full local/manual qualification on one clean candidate SHA: Python/PostgreSQL, live API/browser, Docker/strict acceptance, security/secrets, container inventory, artifact/SBOM/provenance and supported OS/Python matrix; review visual UI manually.
Issue GO only if every mandatory family and human-owned gate passes for that exact candidate; otherwise keep NO-GO and delay publication.
